as_told.title: Admiral Wilson's response to being called into a SCIF

plain: This story is about a Navy admiral named Thomas Wilson and claims about wreckage from UFOs that has been taken apart and copied, which people call reverse engineering. A UFO investigator, James Fox, says he spoke with staff members of the Senate Armed Services Committee, the group of US senators who oversee the military, and they told him about Wilson. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it too: he relays that someone spoke with the people who subpoenaed Wilson, meaning they legally ordered him to testify. In Michels' version this happened in the 2020s, inside a SCIF, a sealed room built for discussing secret information. If true, it would mean senior officials had been questioned under legal order about hidden UFO programmes.
